gizmo.title: Jaantuska Goobaabinta
gizmo.description: Wuxuu abuuraa jaantus la heli karo oo ku salaysan CSV.

configure.title: Cinwaanka Jaantuska
configure.description: Qoraal beddel ah oo la heli karo oo jaantuskaaga ah.

configure.title: Sharraxaadda Jaantuska
configure.description: Sharraxaad la heli karo oo jaantuskaaga ah.

configure.title: Magaca Miisaanka
configure.description: Saamiga ballac:dherer ee jaantuska (Eeg https://gionkunz.github.io/chartist-js/getting-started.html#default-sass-settings si aad u aragto $ct-scales iyo $ct-scales-names).

configure.title: Wadarta
configure.description: Wadar ikhtiyaari ah oo aad qeexi karto. Markaad qeexdo qiimaha wadarta, isugeynta qiimayaasha taxanaha waa inay noqotaa wadartan si loo sawiro goobaabin buuxda. Waxaad isticmaali kartaa halbeeggan si aad u sawirto qaybo goobaabin ah ama jaantusyo cabbir.

configure.title: Iska Indho Tir Qiimayaasha Bannaan
configure.description: Qiimayaasha bannaan waa la iska indho tiri doonaa si looga fogaado sawirista jeexjeexyo iyo calaamado aan loo baahnayn.

advanced.title: Rog Xogta
advanced.description: Rog xogta oo ay ku jiraan calaamadaha, kala horraynta taxanaha iyo sidoo kale dhammaan safafka xogta taxanaha.

advanced.title: Shaxda HTML
advanced.description: Ikhtiyaari: Soo rar xogta sida shax HTML.

advanced.title: Donut Adag
advanced.description: U sawir qaybaha donut-ka qaabab halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen xariiqyo.

advanced.title: Jihada Calaamadda
advanced.description: U sawir qaybaha donut-ka qaabab halkii ay ka ahaan lahaayeen xariiqyo.

advanced.title: Leexinta Calaamadda
advanced.description: Leexinta booska calaamadda ee ka timaadda booska caadiga ah oo ah kala badhka masaafada gacan-qaloocinta. Qiimahan wuxuu noqon karaa mid togan ama taban. Qiimayaasha togan waxay calaamadda ka fogeeyaan dhexda.
